summary: Frontend-only validation of hero subtitle, legal pages (/aviso-de-privacidad, /terminos-y-condiciones), footer links, JSON-LD per route (Home FAQ, /servicios/tarjetas, /blog/repse-2026-que-cambia, /empresas/hoteles), single #route-jsonld tag across SPA navigation, sitemap URL count and runtime regression.
